nom: celimax Jiwoogae Heartleaf BHA Peeling & Exfoliating Pads

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, red-prone skin (especially on the cheeks) report no stinging or irritation and say the pads calm redness while keeping pores clear.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination/oily-T-zone skin reports smaller-looking pores and smoother, less textured, non-irritated skin.

concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness or sensitivity around the cheeks report the pads calm and soothe the skin rather than aggravate it; one reviewer notes mild redness the first night that resolved by morning with improved texture.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers note reduced small clogged pores on the nose and chin and pores that look smaller and clearer after use.

extraits.texte: So far I love this product. Used at bedtime, made skin mildly red, woke up with visibly improved texture. Skin is much smoother and not so dull.

I've been using the Celimax Ji.Woo.Gae Heartleaf BHA Peeling Pads for a 4 years now, and they've quickly become one of my favorite skincare staples. The first thing I noticed is how smooth it leaves my skin, I also have a glow and they don't sting or irritate my skin at all. Instead, they provide a mild, refreshing exfoliation that leaves my face feeling clean and smooth. The heartleaf ingredient really stands out. My skin tends to get a bit sensitive and red, especially around my cheeks, but these pads help calm everything down while still keeping my pores clear. I've also seen a noticeable improvement in texture—my skin looks more even, and those small clogged pores on my nose and chin have reduced significantly. Another big plus is the convenience. The pads are well-soaked but not dripping, and the dual texture makes them versatile—one side gently exfoliates, while the other helps smooth and prep the skin. They're perfect for both morning and nighttime routines. Overall, I'd highly recommend these peeling pads if you're looking for something effective yet gentle. They strike a great balance between exfoliation and soothing care, making them suitable even for sensitive skin types.

extraits.titre: A game changer for makeup prep
extraits.texte: These are incredible exfoliating pads! Theyve become a staple in my skincare/makeup prep. I use these on days when i need to have a smooth base before applying foundation or skin tints. The exfoliating side has a special weave that takes care of the crusty areas around your nose and leaves behind a really smooth canvas.

I have been using these for the past month and I'm impressed. They have been great on my sensitive skin. No adverse reactions! I have restocked on my 2nd container. I love having these in my skincare routine!

This product has literally changed my skin. I am combo oily in my T zone. The textured side of this pad cleanses everything out of my pores and they look smaller! My skin has never felt so smooth! I will not go without this product. My skin looks more even, less textured, and isnt irritated.

reserve: Only six reviews are available and all are positive (5/5), so dissenting or critical perspectives could not be included.
